about: Christina Corwin is a mediator and attorney at Reed Longyear Malnati Corwin & Burnett, who guides parties through divorce/legal separation, non-marital relationships or other family law issues. Christina provides neutral support in helping parties determine fair property distribution, spousal/child support and parenting plans, and has extensive experience working with both simple and complex matters. Christina brings creative solutions to the table as parties navigate their real property, closely held businesses, vested and unvested stock units, trusts, characterization of assets, and retirement distributions among a multitude of other specialized legal issues. Christina’s mediation process supports busy professionals and parties seeking an amicable, fast-tracked and efficient experience.
Christina has more than 25 years of her life assisting the Seattle community with their family law issues, including

Prior to being a mediator and attorney, she taught elementary and middle school students in King County, Washington. As a life-long teacher, she patiently and diligently guides parties through complex legal processes and helps them in recognizing the impact of their legal choices.

Along with her mediation and consulting practice, Christina is currently managing member and department head of her law firm. She was bestowed upon the Professionalism in Practice Award by the Washington State Bar Association in 2005 and the Award for Outstanding Volunteer by the King County Bar Association in 2002 for her professionalism and her work with domestic violence legal clinics, respectively.
